parameters.name: DbId
parameters.description: The ID of the database. You can call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: The name of the selected model. You can use only Qwen series models.

parameters.description: The SQL statement that reports the error.
